Nora: Postmortem follow-up: tracking owners for the regional DNS/LB retry pattern and recurring TLS handshakes during cross-region failovers. Please ack + ETA for your item.

Vik: Ack. I'll take ownership of the routing backoff policy and sticky weight decay. Plan: reduce cross-region retry window, add exponential backoff cap. ETA: config PR by Mon.

Jun: I'll run the e2e + canary tests and validate TLS SNI behavior against older instances. Need Vik's PR link to start. ETA: tests complete Wed AM.

IncidentBot: Incident 2025-12-02 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/regional-dns-retry-2025 (auto-attached)

Maya: Observed DNS TTL misalignments in edge caches causing 20-45s stale routing windows. I'll own telemetry: add ttl_skew metric and dashboard. ETA: Thu.

Harper: I'll author the on-call playbook and Datadog alert text for TLS handshake and SNI mismatch spikes. ETA: Fri.

Vik: Draft routing snippet pushed:
```yaml
failover_policy:
  cross_region:
    max_retries: 1
    backoff_ms: 250
    backoff_cap_ms: 1000
  sticky_decay_seconds: 900
```
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2602

Jun: Canary at 5% to region-west started. Early metrics: retry_count -33%, small SNI mismatch bump 0.11%. Monitoring for 3h.

Nora: Action summary:
- Vik: routing backoff + PR (ETA Mon)
- Jun: canary + e2e (ETA Wed)
- Maya: telemetry & dashboard (ETA Thu)
- Harper: playbook & alert text (ETA Fri)

Maya: Datadog query I'll add:
```
sum:network.dns.ttl_skew{env:prod}.rollup(max,60)
```
Alert: ttl_skew > 20s on >2 edges for 5m.

Harper: Playbook created, alert ID DD-5030. Included quick rollback steps and customer-notice template.

Vik: PR merged with healthcheck tweak to prefer SNI validation early: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2610. Rolling to prod.

Jun: Canary completed, 4h run with stable TLS metrics. Proceeding to 50% ramp tomorrow.

Nora: Great progress. I'll update the postmortem remediation tracker with owners, PRs, alert ID, and close items when confirmed. Please paste final monitoring links and customer outreach snippets here.
